SCHEDULE: {"1":"Hana","2":"Ann","3":"Dev","4":"Ben","5":"Cara","6":"Finn","7":"Gus","8":"Elif","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 99

Ben is immediately after Dev, and Cara is immediately after Ben, so Cara is at Dev+2. Gus is exactly two slots from Cara, and Gus can't be before Dev, so Gus is at Dev+4 and Finn at Dev+3. Hana and Ann must both come before Dev, with Ann directly after Hana, which leaves only slots 1 and 2 for them. That puts Dev in slot 3, and Elif and Ivo fill 8 and 9 in that order.

I checked all 19 constraints against this schedule and each one holds.

The note shared with the team doesn't match this solution. "Elif 9, Ivo 8" breaks Elif-before-Ivo. "Dev in slot 4" breaks Dev-before-Cara, because Cara would have to be at slot 5 or later.
